# Contributing

Open an issue at https://github.com/uuidna/qpu/issues before you start a change, so that it can be agreed first. Report a vulnerability as SECURITY.md describes.

Every change passes the repository's git hooks: its message is a Google CL description and its hand-written code doesn't grow. The licence is in LICENSE.
